cooked: PQC witness pricing needs a separate validation-cost budget, not just a byte discount. A compact signature scheme can still be expensive to verify, and block weight alone won’t bound that work. Any new witness style should specify both its weight accounting and a consensus-enforced CPU cost model, including how costs compose across many inputs.
